rationale: The candidate is visually coherent in all four views and reads as one stepped terraced mass, so gesture, hierarchy, and repair integrity are strong. The stepped silhouette is not problematic as such; it is continuous and capacity-like. However, for the neighborhood-living brief, the mass does not convincingly produce an active ground threshold or a meaningful public void/court on the verified access edge. The form mainly behaves as a sealed compact stepped block, with the blue access edge remaining adjacent rather than being absorbed into an entry seam, notch, or undercut. Section-wise it is generic stacked massing rather than a clearly inhabited ground-plus-public-void relationship. Because the visible mass does not adequately support the program invariants of active frontage and public space, program_fit_hard_pass fails.
